## Component-error explanation completed; preserve justified modern results

The investigator reiterates the scientific objective: explain non-identical results and justify the modern computation, rather than altering it solely to reproduce legacy approximations. This is direction for the work, not broad model acceptance.

A finite parameter-free continuation now reconstructs and retains the previously omitted **two FP64 activation-reference vectors on 384 saved logits**. No model, weights/PCA, framework activation or neural forward was executed. The stable exponential/tanh references agree within `1.11e-16`, round identically to float32 and exactly reproduce the prior accepted aggregate activation statistics. The two new formula vectors are spent and saved; old model allowances remain exhausted.

### What explains the 58 native-closer outputs?

Decompose each total error against the full-head FP64 reference as:
`upstream = FP64_sigmoid(saved_FP32_logit) - full_head_FP64`;
`activation = saved_score - FP64_sigmoid(saved_FP32_logit)`.
The sum reproduces total error with zero residual.

- Ideal activation of the logits preserves the 39 native /12 modern /7 equal upstream comparisons.
- At each engine's **own** logit, native activation error is smaller in 36 of the58 cases, modern in 22. Those arguments differ.
- At **identical native logits**, native activation is closer in **28**, modern in **16**, with **14 equal**. Across all 192 rows the matched-argument counts are 37 native / 83 modern / 72 equal.
- Native upstream/activation errors oppose in 31/58; the final activation actually reduces upstream absolute error in **17/58**. Modern's corresponding counts are 26/58 and 14/58. Opposing errors can overshoot; they do not automatically improve the total.
- In **eight** cases, a more accurate modern activation at identical native logits makes full-head error worse. This directly illustrates compensation, alongside genuine native pointwise operation advantages.

These predicates overlap and measure different things. The earlier 20-case sign indicator compared final versus logit error; it was not a count of every beneficial compensation. Modern's lower aggregate full-head maximum/mean/RMS error remains true; no uniform pointwise or biological superiority follows.

### Seven new ties and a future precision option

Of the seven modern ties, **three** also occur in the full-head FP64 result cast to float32; **four** retain distinct rounded target values.

A **saved-only, unimplemented counterfactual**—FP64 final activation of modern logits, then float32 output—resolves those four ties and raises whole-head FP64-cast matches **47→89**. It improves 59 outputs, worsens 16 and leaves 117 unchanged. Mean error decreases `7.24633e-8→6.53224e-8`, RMS `1.36155e-7→1.34878e-7`; maximum remains `1.0792440363e-6`. It changes returned stable-sort order in **one batch, seed 1012**, and makes the former reversed pair a float32 tie.

This is an actionable optional precision proposal, **not implemented/adopted or qualified in Torch**. Preserve dev3 while preparing consumer receiving; do not force legacy equality or silently change deployment precision/ranking. Original FAILs, values, thresholds, weights/equations and D40 remain intact.

Seven guarded artificial tests pass. Parameter-free analysis: 0.36 s / ~52.3 MiB sampled/HWM worker RSS; saved-only rounding: 0.22 s. CPU 0/1, one numerical thread, nice 10, 30 s per stage, 512 MiB RSS stop, 1 GiB virtual ceiling; within 4 GB task intent. No GPU/retry/network.

Record: `devguide/pytorch_amp_activation_attribution.md`; consumer receipt SHA-256 `50bd26f61970cb2ea5e5560e624626af6b717bb373f0e56f5716c9d825fe07d8`; report SHA-256 `81ee9a649688c9644261a135d22e594b8f9234d6b1ec4502b379c6e99ad6bcb8`. Raw arrays/activations remain local. Consumer receiving work remains in uibcdf/peptidemt#8; no scientific acceptance, commit/push or release follows.

## Bounded numerical explanation complete; private consumer receiving prepared

The investigator confirms that a demonstrably sound/improved modern result should be preserved, with differences explained, rather than changed solely for legacy equivalence. [The provider's completed component-error analysis](https://github.com/uibcdf/hydramp/issues/1#issuecomment-6614434110) separates upstream error, final activation and compensation using two finite parameter-free reference vectors. No new neural/descriptor/Macrel call occurred. The optional higher-precision final-sigmoid counterfactual remains unimplemented; dev3 is unchanged.

### Consumer data path now prepared

New private source module `src/peptidemt/_hydramp_receiving.py` receives an already produced HydrAMP trace. It preserves every returned occurrence in the provider's own order, seed/draw correspondence, native AMP/MIC/descriptors, original token zeros and available latent/PCA/conditioning/decoder-input evidence. Original chemistry remains unresolved; native scores cannot become Macrel AMP/hemolysis. JSON replay reuses the existing exact float-hex encoding.

The module never loads/runs an engine, parses molecular/FASTA data, recomputes descriptors or invents a new selector. It is not exported as a public generation API. Invalid/partial/empty data, ambiguous correspondence and raw anomalous rows remain explicit; unsafe trace attribution is not guessed. Imported generator provenance is not upgraded.

**16 final guarded artificial source checks pass**, including controlled ResultSet/selector composition with explicitly invented Macrel values that disagree with native AMP preference. These are not actual Macrel or H4 tests.

A separate **saved-real-data replay passes for 17 dev3 batches /272 returned occurrences**, covering 256 distinct latent inputs plus repeat. All native values/order/mapping survive exact JSON replay, including **1,693 zero-token positions**. All rows remain; **20 leading-M occurrences** retain the existing Macrel incompatibility. This reuses the frozen accepted execution artifacts without rerunning their models.

Source tests: 0.52 s/~44.2 MiB child RSS high-water; saved replay: 0.62 s/~38.2 MiB. Existing isolated Python 3.14/seven-distribution worker and published Pytest Receptor 1.2.2; provider/network/artifact guards and one-thread CPU limits. No environment installation or new scientific provider call.

### Remaining boundary

This prepares same-modern-provider data fidelity, **not legacy numerical identity**. Actual live worker integration, fresh Macrel join/procedural control, installed-consumer qualification where applicable, attribution and investigator H0–H4 receiving remain pending. Every old model allowance is exhausted. A concrete new host/call plan is being prepared; no scientific acceptance or execution approval is inferred from the instruction to continue.
